To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(1) the model of the relations among work climate, need satisfaction, motivation, and well-being was replicated across countries; (2) the model was more complex in Bulgaria than in the United States; and (3) the relations between need satisfaction and task motivation and the relations between need support and need satisfaction were stronger in the United States than in Bulgaria.
the model fit both the U.S. and Bulgarian samples, that some paths were equivalent across countries and that others were not, and that the model was not equivalent in the two countries.
the self-determination model was supported for both countries, but there were significant cross-country differences in the strength of the paths in the model.

the role that need satisfaction plays in the motivation and adjustment of individuals in work organizations.
the role of need satisfaction in work motivation and psychological adjustment.

the role of need satisfaction in the workplace, the motivational and well-being consequences of need satisfaction, the role of need support from others, and how these processes may be influenced by culture.
